question: Which campus has more to do?
vote_note: Tag a senior who'd join every club, or a parent who still talks about their college days. 😄

a.label: UCF
a.name: University of Central Florida
bullets: Knight-Thon: UCF's largest student-run philanthropy, all for Orlando Health Arnold Palmer Hospital for Children
Free kayak, canoe and paddleboard rentals at Lake Claire with your student ID
Club count covers all UCF campuses

b.label: USF
b.name: University of South Florida
bullets: Bull Market: vendors and student groups outside the Marshall Student Center every Wednesday, for 25+ years
Canoes, kayaks and paddleboards at Riverfront Park on the Hillsborough River, plus Moonlight Canoeing

second.title: Clubs, lakes and a weekly market. 🎉
second.lead: College isn't just class. Here's what each campus offers when you're not studying. Then vote.
